newsitem.title: USA: Thermedics Detection wins $2.75 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Thermedics Detection wins $2.75 mln contract.

text.p: Thermedics Detection Inc said Tuesday that it has been awarded a contract valued at $2.75 million to develop and manufacture advanced explosives-detection equipment for the government of the United Kingdom.
The work will take place over the next 18 months, Thermedics said.

The company's existing line of explosives-detection equipment includes the EGIS system, which is well-accepted in the field of aviation security for scanning both carry-on and checked baggage for a broad range of explosives, Thermedics said.
